purpose: City-specific discovery of official cadastral parcel geometry for Shamli, India; the exact WUP point was preserved and no point-hit inference was made.
name: Shamli

queries.query: Shamli Uttar Pradesh official cadastral map parcel land records GIS
queries.result: First-party results identified Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh, the Shamli district administration site, the official BhuNaksha public viewer, and a Shamli-specific cadastral-map digitization report. The report shows Shamli tehsil villages linked to BhuNaksha and geo-referenced.

queries.query: शामली उत्तर प्रदेश आधिकारिक भू नक्शा खसरा भूमि अभिलेख GIS
queries.result: First-party Hindi results identified the Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh portal and Shamli district site. The official Shamli tehsil report records 121/121 villages linked to BhuNaksha and 111/111 geo-referenced villages.

officialSources.observation: Official Uttar Pradesh dashboard for Shamli tehsil reports 121 villages, 111 linked to BhuNaksha, and 111 geo-referenced; village Shamli is listed with village code 221353.
Official Uttar Pradesh public BhuNaksha viewer exposes district, tehsil, village, plot search, map layers, and plot information.
Official Revenue Council portal describes Uttar Pradesh land records and links parcel/gata, Bhu-Naksha, and mutation services.
Official Shamli district administration page identifies the district and links Land Records as a public utility.

requests.outcome: Current HTML and JavaScript were fetched. The configuration exposed apiUrl https://upbhulekh.gov.in/PublicBhuApi/api and apiForMap https://upbhulekh.gov.in/PublicBhuApi/bhunaksha; no credentials were used.
Shamli tehsil report returned 127 village rows; the Shamli village row has code 221353 and linked/geo-referenced map indicators set to 1.
Public viewer returned current HTML/JavaScript. Query-string preselection was not honored in the bounded request; no login wall or CAPTCHA was encountered.

Bounded anonymous request with giscode 20600707221353 and plotno 1 returned safe map metadata: native map id 0BRfEf0hQlCuKT-JjJfxng and bounding extent xmin 142337.60955483816, ymin 3265683.781163103, xmax 142390.40102996933, ymax 3265774.6856898232. This is not a full polygon response.
Endpoint responded but includes owner and other unsafe attributes; no response was retained and no unsafe fields are part of this packet.
Plot geometry endpoint required an Authorization header. No token, login, or bypass was attempted.

registryBasis: The official Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha service returned Shamli-tehsil map metadata for the official Shamli village code, establishing a public local cadastral map route; full polygon geometry was not verified anonymously.

source.crs: Unverified; response coordinates are map-service units and were not treated as WGS84.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Uttar Pradesh public BhuNaksha and Shamli tehsil cadastral-map service.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Shamli village map linkage and one bounded plot metadata response; no citywide polygon collection.

remainingUncertainty: The public map route is evidenced, but the anonymous geometry endpoint requires authorization and the exact WUP point was not used to infer absence. Map-service coordinate units/CRS and citywide coverage remain unverified.
